## AgentBridge v0.1.3

This patch release fixes Linux remote deployment with VBR-generated Deployment Kits that contain Windows-style path separators.

### Fixed

- Normalize Windows-style `\\` entry separators in Deployment Kit ZIP files before staging them on the target host.
- Continue rejecting absolute, drive-qualified, UNC, and directory-traversal paths after normalization.
- Added regression coverage for `Certificate\\client-cert.pem` and unsafe Windows paths.

The fix was verified against a real VBR-generated Deployment Kit. The release includes Linux amd64, Windows amd64, macOS Intel, and macOS Apple Silicon builds.
